title: What tools do you use to backtest stock strategies without writing code?
author: kenzothai
selftext:
I’m trying to find a cleaner way to test rough stock strategy ideas without turning every idea into a coding project

I don’t really know how to code. tried vibe coding a few times too but tbh it doesn’t work that well for me once the strategy needs proper rules, entries, exits, sizing etc

I know AI tools are everywhere now, but most of what I’ve tried still feels like partial help. some tools help write code, some explain indicators, some are more bot / automation focused, but I still end up jumping between tools and gluing the workflow together myself

for example:

\- TradingView is great for charts, but once I want to properly test rules, I’m still dealing with Pine Script

\- QuantConnect looks powerful, but feels a bit too heavy when I’m just trying to see if an idea is even worth taking seriously

\- I’ve also looked at Option Alpha, 3Commas, and Streak. they all seem useful in their own lane, but I’m not sure if they solve the simple “idea to testable strategy” workflow cleanly



what I’m looking for is basically:

write the idea in normal english → turn it into testable rules → run a backtest → see actual trades and result metrics → tweak it → maybe paper trade the same logic if it doesn’t look terrible

not looking for signals or AI telling me what to buy. I just want to test my own ideas faster

anyone else dealing with this same gap? what tools have you tried and which ones actually worked for you
